# kion_azure_arm_template (Resource)

Manages a Kion Azure Arm Template.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "kion_azure_arm_template" "example" {
  # Required
  deployment_mode          = 1
  name                     = "example"
  resource_group_name      = "example"
  resource_group_region_id = 1
  template                 = "example"

  # Optional
  # description          = "example"
  # owner_user_group_ids = []
  # owner_user_ids       = []
  # template_parameters  = "example"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `deployment_mode` (Number) Deployment mode for the ARM template.
Valid values are either 1 ("incremental") or 2 ("complete")
- `name` (String) The name of the ARM template definition in cloudtamer.io
- `resource_group_name` (String) Name of the resource group where these resources should be deployed
- `resource_group_region_id` (Number) Database ID of the Azure region where the ARM template should be deployed
- `template` (String) Contents of the ARM template to be deployed.

### Optional

- `description` (String) A short description of the ARM template
- `owner_user_group_ids` (Set of Number) List of groups IDs who will own the Azure ARM template. Is required if no user IDs are listed.
- `owner_user_ids` (Set of Number) List of user IDs who will own the Azure ARM template. Is required if no group IDs are listed.
- `template_parameters` (String) Parameters to fill for the template. Should be the contents of the "properties" attribute on the traditional payload.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Azure ARM Template ID.
